payload.description_html: (A–E) ALMNH 3322, paratype, upper right anterior tooth in (A) oral, (B) basal, (C) mesial, (D) lingual, and (E) labial views. (F–J) ALMNH 3566, upper right anterior tooth in (F) lingual, (G) labial, (H) mesial, (I) oral, and (J) basal views. (K–O) ALMNH 3935, upper left anterior tooth, large morphology, in (K) oral, (L) basal, (M) mesial, (N) lingual, and (O) labial views. (P–T) ALMNH 9724, lower right anterior tooth in (P) lingual, (Q) labial, (R) mesial, (S) oral, and (T) basal views. Scale bars equal 1.0 cm.
